why_per_context: Pooled, the corpus scores below the model it would replace. The sequence-potency relationship differs between assays, and adding context as features made it worse, so each assay gets its own model.

a431_4000_gymnosis.evidence: Spearman 0.30 under target-gene-grouped CV on 17,679 sequences in A431, against 0.09 for GC alone and -0.17 for a target-gene-mean baseline that ignores the sequence.
a431_4000_gymnosis.caveat: Predicts knockdown in this assay only. ASO Atlas pools percent inhibition across 81 cell lines and many dosages, and the pooled model scores 0.18 against this context's 0.30. Do not read it as general potency.
